List and inspect the WASM output-parser modules declared in the `parsers` config.

Each module self-describes (via its `describe` export) which tools it can parse,
how to invoke each, and its build-injected version. Results are deduplicated across
every configured parser — a module declared by N tools is described once.

Use --json for machine-readable output (to drive configs or build pipelines), or
--wasm <path> to describe a local .wasm file without any config or network access.

Usage:
  datamitsu devtools parsers [command]

Available Commands:
  inspect     Show full capability detail for one parsed tool
  list        List every tool the configured parser modules can parse (deduplicated)
  prefetch    Download + verify parser modules into the store (for OCI-bundle builds / airgap)
  run         Run a parser on a tool's raw output (from stdin) and print the diagnostics

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for parsers

Global Flags:
      --before-config strings   Configuration file(s) to load before auto-discovery (for wrappers/libraries)
      --binary-command string   Override the binary command (for npm package wrappers, etc). Can also be set via DATAMITSU_BINARY_COMMAND env var
      --config strings          Additional configuration file(s) to load and merge (can be specified multiple times)
      --log-format string       Status output format: console or jsonl (also via DATAMITSU_LOG_FORMAT)
      --no-auto-config          Disable auto-discovery of datamitsu.config.{js,mjs,ts} at git root
      --no-oci                  Disable OCI bundle store seeding (also via DATAMITSU_NO_OCI)
      --no-parse                Skip output parsers; show tools' raw output instead (also via DATAMITSU_NO_PARSE)
  -v, --verbose                 Enable debug-level logging (default level is warn)

Use "datamitsu devtools parsers [command] --help" for more information about a command.
